content: Abraham pathlah, David pathlah a cangpaw Zisu Khri thokehnah cazing leco,
Abraham cawh Isak a paw cang ka,

content.text: Isak cawh Jakob a paw a cang.
Jakob cawh Judah le a uny sahlo aa paw a cang.
Judah cawh Perez le Zera aa paw cang ka, aa no cawh Tama a cang.
Perez cawh Hezron a paw cang ka,
Hezron cawh Ram a paw a cang.
Ram cawh Aminada a paw cang ka,
Aminada cawh Nashon a paw a cang.
Nashon cawh Salmon a paw a cang,
Salmon cawh Boaz a paw cang ka, a no cawh Rahab a cang.
Boaz cawh Obed a paw cang ka, a no cawh Ruth a cang.
Obed cawh Jesi a paw cang ka,
Jesi cawh siangpahrang David a paw a cang.

content: David cawh Solomon a paw cang ka, Solomon a no cawh Uria a nupui tawpaw khah a cang.

content.text: Solomon cawh Rehoboam a paw cang ka,
Rehoboam cawh Abija a paw a cang.
Abija cawh Asa a paw cang ka,
Asa cawh Jehoshafat a paw a cang.
Jehoshafat cawh Jehoram a paw cang ka,
Jehoram cawh Uziah a paw a cang.
Uziah cawh Jotham a paw cang ka,
Jotham cawh Ahas a paw a cang.
Ahas cawh Hezekia a paw cang ka,
Hezekia cawh Manaseh a paw a cang.
Manaseh cawh Amon a paw cang ka,
Amon cawh Josai a paw a cang.
Josai cawh Jekhonia le a uny sahlo aa paw cang ka, ma cai leco Babilon raang lang khah sae tah seikhui a cang he.

content: Babilon raang lang sae tah seikhui aa cang khy taiteipaw:

content.text: Jekhonia cawh Shealtia a paw a cang.
Shealtia cawh Zerubabel a paw cang ka,
Zerubabel cawh Abiud a paw a cang.
Abiud cawh Eliakim a paw cang ka,
Eliakim cawh Azor a paw a cang.
Azor cawh Zadok a paw cang ka,
Zadok cawh Akhim a paw a cang.
Akhim cawh Eliud a paw cang ka,
Eliud cawh Eleazar a paw a cang.
Eleazar cawh Mathan a paw cang ka,
Mathan cawh Jakob a paw a cang.
Jakob cawh Khri tatei aa tahpaw Zisu a no Mari a pasaepaw Josef a paw khah a cang.

content: Ma hrahei Abraham taitah David tai letah chaihraw hluipali, David taitah Babilon raang lang sae tah seikhui aa cangnah tai letah chaihraw hluipali, sae tah seikhui aa cangnah taitah Khri
a pinah tai letah chaihraw hluipali a cang.

Zisu Khri a pinah konglang cawh ma hrahei a cang. A no Mari cawh Josef khatah a pahlawng pawtah pahapaw a cang. Canghrasala aa pahlawng hlai he tah Mari cawh Thlawpaw Pathai hmingtuakhynah thongtah sawtei a pho.
A pasae ruapaw Josef cawh mehding mehchaw a cangnah cawtah mingzawpui hme letah Mari a ningzawsah khah du be ca ka, kaa pahlawng peh aa tahpaw khah aparuh teitah bia ka pheh kaw a tatah a pacang.

Canghrasala, ma hratei a pacang khy taico, Abuipaw a vaiming pakheh cawh ama khatah a mang letah a za paly ka, a hai letah, “David pathlah a cangpaw Josef, Mari cawh nupui rua tah chui pawtah lung ngerai lytah ung kheh. Zecawtamaw tatah punglong lytah a cangpaw khah Thlawpaw Pathai thongtah a cang.
Sawcapaw sah a ka, a ming tah Zisu
na sá a. Zecawtamaw tatah Ama taco a cawngsaw sahlo khah aa suanah taitah a pachá he a,” tatah a tah.
Ma hming vytei a va ungpaw heh Abuipaw tah Khazing khuavang hmang tei a reipaw:
“Laisaw pathai tah sawtei pho ka, sawcapaw a sá a, Ama cawh Immanuel tatah aa y a,” tatah a tah. Immanuel a silang cawh, “Khazing kaaning khatah a ung,” tahnah a cang.
Josef cawh a ka hraw tihtah Abuipaw a vaiming tei a chingpaw hrakhei tua ka, Mari cawh nupui ruapaw takhei ing lang cawh a chui.
Canghrasala sawcapaw a sah hlai vytei khah cawh ung hrui be. Taico sawcapaw a sahpaw cawh Zisu tatah ming a sah.

footnotes.text: Khri (Grik rei), Mesiah (Hebru rei) aa silang cawh, Sathy thupaw,tahnah a cang.
Zisu cawh, Pachahtu Buipaw,tahnah a cang.
